_comment: The declared crossings of the model/view boundary, enforced by the juggler/sdk-boundary ESLint rule (tooling/eslint.config.js): web/js/model/**, web/js/services/** and web/js/registries/** may not import web/js/components/**. A UI command the model or a service needs goes through a port the component registers into (services/ui-port.js, services/settings-launcher.js). Each entry below is logic that lives in a component module but is not a component, and says what it is; moving it out of components/ removes the entry. An entry whose import is gone fails the lint.

web/js/services/context-menu-service.js.why: insertAtCaret is the composer's token-aware text insertion, not a view; it lives beside the paste tokens it must keep intact

web/js/services/shortcut-bindings.js.why: the find shortcuts open and step the find bar, whose singleton and panel lookup live in its own module
